$comment: Frictionless Table Schema plus x-papiamento extensions read by tools/validate.py. See _meta/conventions.md (Audits).
title: Audits: random samples of a table checked against the source PDFs

fields.name: table
fields.description: What was audited: a table of the README progress table. translations means the en, nl and es cells of word rows; grammar the files in grammar/; rules the machine rules in rules/rules.jsonl.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: Sampled rows found wrong against the source page; at most sample_size

fields.name: method
fields.description: How the sample was drawn (and its seed) and what counted as an error

fields.name: auditor
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the people who checked the sample, separated by '; '; machine when software or an AI model did the checking

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Doubtful rows, the errata or fixes the audit led to, a link to the report
